ItemDescription.Value:
[b]ModReady[/b] — save-load and crash guards for Bannerlord, as an optional add-on that runs on top of BUTR's dependency stack.
[b]What it does[/b] - Removes corrupt leftover troops (e.g. orphaned retinues) from party rosters on load, so the map and party screens stop freezing - Guards the tooltip text lookup and map-bar refresh so a broken mod can't hang the campaign map on load - Fixes the main-menu Continue save-load loop with mismatched modules - Loads mods that ship several per-game-version DLLs without corrupting the save system - Catches mod patches built against older game versions and names the culprit mod in runtime.log
[b]Requires[/b] BUTR's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859188632]Harmony[/url]. Load order: Harmony, then ModReady, then your other mods.
ModReady no longer ships its own Harmony/UIExtenderEx/ButterLib/MCM — use BUTR's originals. If you were subscribed to the old ModReady dependency items, unsubscribe from them.
